finding: Merged main was broken: submission_writer imported assert_submittable, which PR #3's validate.py did not define; tests could not import.
action: Fixed: validate.py now exposes the union API (validate, assert_submittable, template_meta, write_submission). 22 tests pass.

finding: tests/ imported gems57.* (a sibling package name) and an older uniqueness API.
action: Fixed: imports renamed to gems61; uniqueness.py re-implemented with surface_rho / dot_overlap / compare / load_registry; limits 0.90 / 0.70 / Jaccard 0.50.

finding: Three data layouts (data/official, data/bridge, data/raw) expected by three generations of code; the link directories are git-ignored, so a fresh clone failed.
action: Fixed: prepare_data.py now creates the data/bridge and data/raw symlinks (recorded in evidence/data_preparation.json).

finding: Earlier sessions reported that the catalogue-frame holdout anti-correlates with live scores (ρ ≈ −0.93) and treated the instrument as inverted. The anti-correlation is an artefact: the top live files were pruned against the full catalogue, which removes exactly the dots a catalogue holdout rewards.
action: Protocol corrected: withhold whole segments; prune only against the visible catalogue; score registry files as-is with the caveat; use the unpruned dotted base as the bar.

finding: An earlier raster in this repo (gems61-lane-buried-step-…-k400k, 311,617 px) is a near-blanket: 95.8% of the footprint is within 3 px of it, so the one-sided 70% overlap rule flags every file as a duplicate of it.
action: Gate uses Jaccard (limit 0.50) when the reference has > 5× the candidate's support; raw overlap, base rate and Jaccard are all reported (evidence/h61g_uniqueness.json).

finding: Before this session the repo advertised three different 'primary' files (root index.html said READY TO DOWNLOAD for one, README named another, the run card said negative).
action: All three are marked SUPERSEDED; a single status block now appears on index.html, the executive summary and README.

finding: Undamped Oldenburg iteration diverges on the isostatic residual (reproduced).
action: Damped, band-limited iteration (kc_scale 0.5); documented in method.

finding: The lane brief's 3 × 3 ribbons halve the holdout score for a 100 m-accurate locator (0.0465 → 0.0216 on identical cells).
action: Shipped the validated dots; multi-line character kept at corridor scale; both variants reported.

finding: The sandbox allow-list blocks drivendata.org downloads and raw.githubusercontent.com; data came from the hash-pinned public bridge, not from an organiser receipt.
action: Provenance class recorded as 'public bridge' in evidence/data_preparation.json; sha256 pins verified.
